collectedByClientSide
string
enabled
optional
read/write
When enabled, client side connections collect TCP analytics data unless directed otherwise by iRule. If false, client side connections only collect data if directed by iRule.
collectedByServerSide
string
optional
read/write
When enabled, server side connections collect TCP analytics data unless directed otherwise by iRule. If false, server side connections only collect data if directed by iRule.

collectedStatsInternalLogging

When enabled, TCP statistics are logged on the local BIG-IP.
